records.prompt:
Create a production sprite sheet for the cozy pixel-art guild-room game, using image 1 as the EXACT character identity, clothing, proportions, dark outline and detailed warm pixel-painted style reference. Image 2 is the wooden chair reference. Transparent RGBA background. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACTLY 12 separate whole-character sprites arranged on an invisible regular 4-column by 3-row grid (384 x 341 cells). Keep 32 pixels clear margin within each cell. No text, grid, labels, ground, cast shadow, glow or extra people. Keep character head size absolutely constant across all frames, with head center horizontally centered in each cell. Full bodies and feet remain inside cells.
Read cells LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
1-6: SIX successive frames of ONE complete walking cycle AWAY from viewer, showing the BACK of head and clothing, feet alternate left-right. Frame1 left heel contact,2 left support/right passing,3 right leg swings forward,4 right heel contact,5 right support/left passing,6 left leg swings forward. Small natural stride, gentle reciprocal arm swing. No turning toward viewer. Same back view and head shape in all six frames. Walking in place, pelvis centered, no sideways sway, no zoom or size change. Feet near bottom of each cell.
7: THREE-QUARTER RIGHT facing character sitting politely ON the wooden chair from image2, holding a small handled teacup at chest with ONLY the RIGHT hand through its handle. The LEFT hand rests relaxed on their lap, never touching the cup. INCLUDE the chair as part of this sprite. Upright back, hips on green seat, thighs extend only a short distance horizontally, knees bent 90 degrees, lower legs vertical and boots resting below knees. NOT cross-legged, NOT floor sitting, NOT knees hugged to chest.
8: IDENTICAL chair and seated body, only the RIGHT hand and cup move upward to lips, LEFT hand remains resting on lap and eyes become happy. Chair legs reach same baseline as frame7.
9-10: TWO-frame BACK VIEW standing workbench animation. Body faces directly AWAY/up toward an imaginary bench ahead. Frame9 both arms reach forward at waist/chest level, RIGHT hand holds a small hammer down; frame10 RIGHT elbow and hammer lifted slightly. Hammer MUST remain in the RIGHT hand in BOTH frames (viewer RIGHT in back view), LEFT hand rests forward to steady the work. NEVER swap hands. Show back of head, not face. Do NOT include workbench or any other furniture. Feet stationary. Keep head/body absolutely unchanged between pair.
11-12: TWO-frame BACK VIEW standing paperwork animation, facing AWAY/up toward imaginary desk ahead. One hand holds paper forward, other writes with quill; alternate small hand gesture only. NO actual desk. Feet stationary. Head/body unchanged.
All sprites same figure size. Preserve reference outfit details from back plausibly; do not make new accessories. Source background is transparent: preserve that. Produce clean fully opaque sprite interiors and clean alpha silhouette, no haze.

records.prompt:
Create a TRANSPARENT RGBA sprite sheet for the same cozy warm detailed pixel-art guild-home game as the reference furniture sheet. 1536x1024, EXACTLY six isolated small props in 3 columns x 2 rows, each 512 square. Slight overhead three-quarter view matching reference, dark brown pixel outlines, readable at small display. No text, frames, cast shadows, background, people, giant tower or scenery panorama. Leave at least 40 transparent pixels around every object.
TOP LEFT: cheerful sunny village garden backdrop section: short white plaster garden wall with honey-colored wooden gate and climbing small white flowers, width400 height220, warm greens.
TOP CENTER: garden tool corner: watering barrel, two clay pots and a neat stack of seedling trays, warm wood.
TOP RIGHT: shaded woodland cultivation drying shelter: dark weathered timber lean-to roof over a rack with bundles of drying herbs and a small crate, moss and a few ivy leaves. NOT a tower. Width400 height280.
BOTTOM LEFT: a low split-rail fence with fern tufts and moist mossy grey stones underneath, cool forest greens, width400 height150.
BOTTOM CENTER: a compact lush patch of pale-green medicinal herbs with a few tiny cream flowers in SOIL, horizontal oval only width260 height120. No frame, no wooden planter.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a compact low cushion of dark teal moss on moist soil, a few light blue-green new tips, NO GLOW, no flowers, no planter, width260 height100.
Keep warm pixel-art texture density and sharp clear silhouettes of reference. Transparent outside the objects.
